snippet.title: Kuromaku Demo Trailer (Psychological Thriller Game)
snippet.description:
Step into the unsettling world of Kuromaku.

In this slow-burn psychological horror demo, you move into your father’s apartment following your parents’ divorce. At first, life seems ordinary — unpack boxes, share breakfast, clean the bathroom, restock the kitchen. But the quiet routine begins to unravel. A bathroom door opens on its own. A delivery man’s face feels eerily familiar. Your father’s persistent cough echoes through the walls… but you’re not sure you’re truly alone.

👁️ Key Features:
– Narrative-driven horror prologue introducing the world and tone of the main game
– Everyday chores distorted into unsettling encounters
– Psychological tension that lingers long after you stop playing

This is only the demo. The full game will reveal the complete story.

🕯️ Support the project:
👉 Wishlist Kuromaku on Steam: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/3950390/Kuromaku_Demo/]
👉 Play the demo September 18, 2025
👉 Share your review to help shape the full release
